items.name: female
items.description: Female (♀) is the sex of an organism, or a part of an organism, which produces mobile ova (egg cells).

items.name: hermaphrodite
items.description: One organism having both male and female sexual characteristics and organs; at birth an unambiguous assignment of male or female cannot be made.

items.name: male
items.description: Male (♂) refers to the sex of an organism, or part of an organism, which produces small mobile gametes, called spermatozoa.
